authorityBoundary: EveElectron owns generic Electron shell projection, window lifecycle, packaged app build glue, provider advertisement consumption, command transport, capture, and shell-level plugin projection adapters. Aetheria owns Starbridge state, product-specific RTS flows, assets, command authorization, receipts, and authored provider surfaces. Eve keeps the surface, command, provider advertisement, plugin advertisement, and conformance contracts.

moveSets.replacementProof: EveElectron hosts a provider-agnostic Electron shell that loads provider advertisements and lowers Eve surfaces without importing Aetheria client modules.
Electron emits gamecult.eve.command.v1 intents through the provider-advertised command boundary and receives provider receipts instead of mutating local product state.
EveElectron attaches desktop-window capture artifacts to conformance output for at least one non-Aetheria provider and one Aetheria scenario.

forbiddenImports: Aetheria RTS client modules as EveElectron runtime authority
Aetheria Starbridge state as Electron shell truth
provider-specific IPC contracts that bypass gamecult.eve.command.v1
renderer-local product state as daemon truth
requiredExternalProofs: EveElectron publishes a runtime capability manifest with provider advertisement consumption and command transport.
EveElectron owns a provider-shell contract skeleton that selects advertised provider surfaces and emits gamecult.eve.command.v1 intents.
EveElectron lowers at least one generic Eve provider surface that is not Aetheria.
EveElectron lowers Aetheria world/editor surfaces through provider advertisements without importing Aetheria internals.
Aetheria keeps Starbridge-specific UI, assets, authored flows, and receipts in the Aetheria repo.
EveElectron attaches Electron capture artifacts to conformance output.
